name: is_mgmt_action_frame

params.purpose: frame control byte; bits 2-3 must be 0 (management type), subtype in bits 4-7
action frame category/length byte used to filter 0xd0 action frames

docstring: Return true if the frame control byte is a disassociation (0xa0), deauthentication (0xc0), or action (0xd0, subject to category checks) management frame.
